payload.content: E0502 means you tried to take a mutable borrow while an immutable borrow of the same value is still alive. Under non-lexical lifetimes a borrow ends at its last use, so reorder the code so the immutable reference is no longer used before mutating, clone the data you need, or restructure with indices instead of iterators.
